facts.fact: The Whistler reports that Abia State Police Command trained selected officers, concluding 23 April 2024, on a computerised crime and incident database for reporting crime and incidents in addition to manual record keeping, introduced to area commanders and DPOs.
facts.system: Abia Police Command crime, incident and personnel database

systems.system: Abia Command crime, incident and personnel database

NGA.note: The source does not say stations enter reports in the database when taken, or how many stations use it.
